title: चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 40 · The sage Devasharma and his wife

summary.en: Bhishma agrees that what Yudhishthira says of women is true and tells of the sage Devasharma, who, wishing to perform a sacrifice, thought how to guard his wife Ruchi. He called his pupil Vipula and told him to guard her by yoga power, and then went away to the sacrifice.
summary.kn: ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ಮಾತು ಸತ್ಯವೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಒಪ್ಪಿ ಋಷಿ ದೇವಶರ್ಮನ ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಯಜ್ಞ ಮಾಡಲು ಬಯಸಿದ ಅವನು ಪತ್ನಿ ರುಚಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಕಾಯುವುದೆಂದು ಚಿಂತಿಸಿದ. ಶಿಷ್ಯ ವಿಪುಲನಿಗೆ ಯೋಗಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಕಾಯಲು ಹೇಳಿ ಯಜ್ಞಕ್ಕೆ ತೆರಳಿದ.
summary.hi: भीष्म स्त्रियों के बारे में युधिष्ठिर की बात को सत्य मानते हैं और ऋषि देवशर्मा की कथा कहते हैं जिन्होंने यज्ञ करने की इच्छा से पत्नी रुचि की रक्षा के उपाय पर विचार किया। उन्होंने शिष्य विपुल से योगबल से उसकी रक्षा करने को कहा और यज्ञ को चले गए।
summary.te: స్త్రీల గురించి యుధిష్ఠిరుని మాట నిజమని భీష్ముడు ఒప్పి ఋషి దేవశర్మ కథ చెబుతాడు; యజ్ఞం చేయాలనుకున్న అతడు భార్య రుచిని ఎలా కాపాడాలని ఆలోచించాడు. శిష్యుడు విపులునికి యోగబలంతో ఆమెను కాపాడమని చెప్పి యజ్ఞానికి వెళ్లాడు.
summary.ta: பெண்கள் பற்றிய யுதிஷ்டிரரின் சொல் உண்மை என்று பீஷ்மர் ஒப்புக்கொண்டு முனிவர் தேவசர்மாவின் கதையைக் கூறுகிறார்; வேள்வி செய்ய விரும்பிய அவர் மனைவி ருசியை எவ்வாறு காப்பது என்று எண்ணினார். சீடன் விபுலனிடம் யோக ஆற்றலால் அவளைக் காக்கச் சொல்லி வேள்விக்குச் சென்றார்.
summary.ml: യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ സ്ത്രീകളെക്കുറിച്ച് പറഞ്ഞത് സത്യമാണെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ സമ്മതിക്കുന്നു; യാഗം ചെയ്യാനാഗ്രഹിച്ച ദേവശർമ്മ മുനി ഭാര്യ രുചിയെ എങ്ങനെ സംരക്ഷിക്കുമെന്ന് ചിന്തിക്കുന്ന കഥ അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു. ശിഷ്യനായ വിപുലനെ വിളിച്ച് യോഗശക്തികൊണ്ട് അവളെ സംരക്ഷിക്കാൻ പറഞ്ഞ ശേഷം മുനി യാഗത്തിനായി പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.40; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
एवमेतन्महाबाहो नात्र मिथ्यास्ति किंचन ।
यथा ब्रवीषि कौरव्य नारीं प्रति जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: It is just so, mighty-armed one; there is nothing false here in what you say about women, descendant of Kuru.

verses.text:
अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि इतिहासं पुरातनम् ।
यथा रक्षा कृता पूर्वं विपुलेन महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: Here I will tell you an ancient tale, of how in earlier times the great-souled Vipula guarded his teacher's wife.

verses.text:
प्रमदाश्च यथा सृष्टा ब्रह्मणा भरतर्षभ ।
यदर्थं तच्च ते तात प्रवक्ष्ये वसुधाधिप ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, I will also tell you how and why Brahma created women, dear son.

verses.text:
न हि स्त्रीभ्य परं पुत्र पापीयः किंचिदस्ति वै ।
अग्निर्हि प्रमदा दीप्तो मायाश्च मयजा विभो ।
क्षुरधारा विषं सर्पो मृत्युरित्येकतः स्त्रियः ॥

meaning.en: My son, there is nothing worse than women. Women are blazing fire, and illusions born of the Maya. A razor's edge, poison, a snake, death: all these on one side, women on the other.

verses.text:
इमाः प्रजा महाबाहो धार्मिका इति नः श्रुतम् ।
स्वयं गच्छन्ति देवत्वं ततो देवानियाद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: We have heard, mighty-armed one, that these creatures were righteous and went by themselves to the state of gods. Then the gods felt fear.

verses.text:
अथाभ्यगच्छन्देवास्ते पितामहमरिंदम ।
निवेद्य मानसं चापि तूष्णीमासन्नवाङ्मुखाः ॥

meaning.en: So the gods, scourge of foes, went to the Grandfather, told him what was in their minds, and stood silent with faces lowered.

verses.text:
तेषामन्तर्गतं ज्ञात्वा देवानां स पितामहः ।
मानवानां प्रमोहार्थं कृत्या नार्योऽसृजत्प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: Knowing what was in the gods' hearts, the Grandfather, the lord, created women as a kind of spell to bewilder men.

verses.text:
पूर्वसर्गे तु कौन्तेय साध्व्यो नार्य इहाभवन् ।
असाध्व्यस्तु समुत्पन्ना कृत्या सर्गात्प्रजापतेः ॥

meaning.en: Son of Kunti, in the first creation women here were virtuous. The unvirtuous ones arose later from Prajapati's creation as a spell.

verses.text:
ताभ्यः कामान्यथाकामं प्रादाद्धि स पितामहः ।
ताः कामलुब्धाः प्रमदाः प्रामथ्नन्त नरांस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: The Grandfather gave them desires, as they desired. Greedy for desire, those women then tormented men.

verses.text:
क्रोधं कामस्य देवेशः सहायं चासृजत्प्रभुः ।
असज्जन्त प्रजाः सर्वाः कामक्रोधवशं गताः ॥

meaning.en: The lord of the gods also created anger as the ally of desire. All beings, in the power of desire and anger, became attached.

verses.text:
न च स्त्रीणां क्रिया काचिदिति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः ।
निरिन्द्रिया अमन्त्राश्च स्त्रियोऽनृतमिति श्रुतिः ॥

meaning.en: It was fixed as dharma that women have no rites of their own, and the Shruti says that women are without sense of ritual, without mantras, and a falsehood.

verses.text:
शय्यासनमलंकारमन्नपानमनार्यताम् ।
दुर्वाग्भावं रतिं चैव ददौ स्त्रीभ्यः प्रजापतिः ॥

meaning.en: Prajapati gave women bed, seat, ornament, food and drink, unworthiness, harsh speech and love of pleasure.

verses.text:
न तासां रक्षणं कर्तुं शक्यं पुंसा कथंचन ।
अपि विश्वकृता तात कुतस्तु पुरुषैरिह ॥

meaning.en: A man can never manage to guard them, dear son; even the Maker of the universe could not, let alone men here.

verses.text:
वाचा वा वधबन्धैर्वा क्लेशैर्वा विविधैस्तथा ।
न शक्या रक्षितुं नार्यस्ता हि नित्यमसंयताः ॥

meaning.en: By words, by killing or binding, or by various torments, women cannot be guarded, for they are always unrestrained.

verses.text:
इदं तु पुरुषव्याघ्र पुरस्ताच्छ्रुतवानहम् ।
यथा रक्षा कृता पूर्वं विपुलेन गुरुस्त्रियः ॥

meaning.en: Tiger among men, I have heard this before: how in an earlier time Vipula guarded his teacher's wife.

verses.text:
ऋषिरासीन्महाभागो देवशर्मेति विश्रुतः ।
तस्य भार्या रुचिर्नाम रूपेणासदृशी भुवि ॥

meaning.en: There was a greatly blessed sage named Devasharma. His wife was Ruchi, whose beauty had no equal on earth.

verses.text:
तस्य रूपेण संमत्ता देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।
विशेषतस्तु राजेन्द्र वृत्रहा पाकशासनः ॥

meaning.en: Gods, gandharvas and danavas were all infatuated with her beauty, and especially, king of kings, Indra, slayer of Vritra, the punisher of Paka.

verses.text:
नारीणां चरितज्ञश्च देवशर्मा महामुनिः ।
यथाशक्ति यथोत्साहं भार्यां तामभ्यरक्षत ॥

meaning.en: The great sage Devasharma knew the ways of women, and he guarded his wife as well as his strength and effort allowed.

verses.text:
पुरंदरं च जानीते परस्त्रीकामचारिणम् ।
तस्माद्यत्नेन भार्याया रक्षणं स चकार ह ॥

meaning.en: He also knew Indra as one who pursued other men's wives, so he took care to guard his wife.

verses.text:
स कदाचिदृषिस्तात यज्ञं कर्तुमनास्तदा ।
भार्यासंरक्षणं कार्यं कथं स्यादित्यचिन्तयत् ॥

meaning.en: Once, dear son, that sage wished to perform a sacrifice and wondered how his wife could be kept safe.

verses.text:
रक्षाविधानं मनसा स विचिन्त्य महातपाः ।
आहूय दयितं शिष्यं विपुलं प्राह भार्गवम् ॥

meaning.en: After thinking in his mind about arrangements for her protection, the great ascetic called his dear pupil, Vipula, a descendant of Bhrigu, and said:

verses.text:
यज्ञकारो गमिष्यामि रुचिं चेमां सुरेश्वरः ।
पुत्र प्रार्थयते नित्यं तां रक्षस्व यथाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: I will go to perform a sacrifice. The lord of the gods constantly desires this Ruchi. Son, guard her with all your strength.

verses.text:
अप्रमत्तेन ते भाव्यं सदा प्रति पुरंदरम् ।
स हि रूपाणि कुरुते विविधानि भृगूद्वह ॥

meaning.en: You must always be vigilant against Indra, for he takes many different forms, descendant of Bhrigu.

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो विपुलस्तेन तपस्वी नियतेन्द्रियः ।
सदैवोग्रतपा राजन्नग्न्यर्कसदृशद्युतिः ॥

meaning.en: So addressed by him, Vipula, an ascetic of controlled senses, always of fierce austerity, radiant as fire and sun,

verses.text:
धर्मज्ञः सत्यवादी च तथेति प्रत्यभाषत ।
पुनश्चेदं महाराज पप्रच्छ प्रस्थितं गुरुम् ॥

meaning.en: knowing dharma and truthful, said: So be it. Then, great king, he asked his teacher, who was about to leave, again:

verses.text:
कानि रूपाणि शक्रस्य भवन्त्यागच्छतो मुने ।
वपुस्तेजश्च कीदृग्वै तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: Sage, what forms does Indra take when he comes? What is his body and his splendor like? Please explain that to me.

verses.text:
ततः स भगवांस्तस्मै विपुलाय महात्मने ।
आचचक्षे यथातत्त्वं मायां शक्रस्य भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then the venerable one told the great-souled Vipula in truth about Indra's illusions, Bharata.

verses.text:
बहुमायः स विप्रर्षे बलहा पाकशासनः ।
तांस्तान्विकुरुते भावान्बहूनथ मुहुर्मुहुः ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin sage, the slayer of Bala and punisher of Paka has many illusions. He changes into many kinds of states, again and again.

verses.text:
किरीटी वज्रभृद्धन्वी मुकुटी बद्धकुण्डलः ।
भवत्यथ मुहूर्तेन चण्डालसमदर्शनः ॥

meaning.en: With a crown, a thunderbolt, a bow, a diadem and bound earrings, then in a moment he appears like an outcaste.

verses.text:
शिखी जटी चीरवासाः पुनर्भवति पुत्रक ।
बृहच्छरीरश्च पुनः पीवरोऽथ पुनः कृशः ॥

meaning.en: My boy, he becomes crested, matted-haired, or bark-clad again, then large-bodied, then stout, then lean.

verses.text:
गौरं श्यामं च कृष्णं च वर्णं विकुरुते पुनः ।
विरूपो रूपवांश्चैव युवा वृद्धस्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: He changes his color again, fair, dark or black, ugly or handsome, young or old.

verses.text:
प्राज्ञो जडश्च मूकश्च ह्रस्वो दीर्घस्तथैव च ।
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियश्चैव वैश्यः शूद्रस्तथैव च ।
प्रतिलोमानुलोमश्च भवत्यथ शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Wise or dull, mute, short or tall, a brahmin, kshatriya, vaishya or shudra, of mixed or pure birth, Indra becomes all these.

verses.text:
शुकवायसरूपी च हंसकोकिलरूपवान् ।
सिंहव्याघ्रगजानां च रूपं धारयते पुनः ॥

meaning.en: He takes the form of a parrot, a crow, a swan, a cuckoo, and then the form of a lion, a tiger or an elephant.

verses.text:
दैवं दैत्यमथो राज्ञां वपुर्धारयतेऽपि च ।
सुकृशो वायुभग्नाङ्गः शकुनिर्विकृतस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: He also takes the body of a god, a daitya or a king, or of a very thin man with limbs broken by wind, or a bird, or a misshapen creature.

verses.text:
चतुष्पाद्बहुरूपश्च पुनर्भवति बालिशः ।
मक्षिकामशकादीनां वपुर्धारयतेऽपि च ॥

meaning.en: Again he becomes a four-footed animal of many shapes, or a fool, and he also takes the body of flies, mosquitoes and the like.

verses.text:
न शक्यमस्य ग्रहणं कर्तुं विपुल केनचित् ।
अपि विश्वकृता तात येन सृष्टमिदं जगत् ॥

meaning.en: Vipula, no one can seize him, not even the Maker of the universe by whom this world was created.

verses.text:
पुनरन्तर्हितः शक्रो दृश्यते ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
वायुभूतश्च स पुनर्देवराजो भवत्युत ॥

meaning.en: Indra is seen again, vanished, only by the eye of knowledge, and the king of the gods becomes air.

verses.text:
एवं रूपाणि सततं कुरुते पाकशासनः ।
तस्माद्विपुल यत्नेन रक्षेमां तनुमध्यमाम् ॥

meaning.en: So the punisher of Paka constantly takes forms. Therefore, Vipula, guard this slender-waisted woman with effort.

verses.text:
यथा रुचिं नावलिहेद्देवेन्द्रो भृगुसत्तम ।
क्रतावुपहितं न्यस्तं हविः श्वेव दुरात्मवान् ॥

meaning.en: Best of the Bhrigus, so that the lord of the gods, wicked-minded, does not lick Ruchi like a dog licking an offering set out at a sacrifice.

verses.text:
एवमाख्याय स मुनिर्यज्ञकारोऽगमत्तदा ।
देवशर्मा महाभागस्ततो भरतसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, the sage Devasharma, greatly blessed, went off then to perform his sacrifice, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
विपुलस्तु वचः श्रुत्वा गुरोश्चिन्तापरोऽभवत् ।
रक्षां च परमां चक्रे देवराजान्महाबलात् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing his teacher's words, Vipula became anxious and made the highest protection against the powerful king of the gods.

verses.text:
किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं गुरुदाराभिरक्षणे ।
मायावी हि सुरेन्द्रोऽसौ दुर्धर्षश्चापि वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: What can I do to guard my teacher's wife? That lord of the gods is a master of illusion, hard to resist and mighty.

verses.text:
नापिधायाश्रमं शक्यो रक्षितुं पाकशासनः ।
उटजं वा तथा ह्यस्य नानाविधसरूपता ॥

meaning.en: Even by closing up the hermitage or the hut, I cannot guard against Indra, for he has many forms.

verses.text:
वायुरूपेण वा शक्रो गुरुपत्नीं प्रधर्षयेत् ।
तस्मादिमां संप्रविश्य रुचिं स्थास्येऽहमद्य वै ॥

meaning.en: Or as air Indra might assault my teacher's wife. Therefore, entering Ruchi, I will stay in her this very day.

verses.text:
अथ वा पौरुषेणेयमशक्या रक्षितुं मया ।
बहुरूपो हि भगवाञ्छ्रूयते हरिवाहनः ॥

meaning.en: Or else I cannot guard her by manly effort alone, for the venerable one with the tawny horses is said to take many forms.

verses.text:
सोऽहं योगबलादेनां रक्षिष्ये पाकशासनात् ।
गात्राणि गात्रैरस्याहं संप्रवेक्ष्येऽभिरक्षितुम् ॥

meaning.en: So by the power of yoga I will guard her from Indra. I will enter her limbs with my limbs to protect her.

verses.text:
यद्युच्छिष्टामिमां पत्नीं रुचिं पश्येत मे गुरुः ।
शप्स्यत्यसंशयं कोपाद्दिव्यज्ञानो महातपाः ॥

meaning.en: If my teacher were to see his wife Ruchi defiled, that great ascetic of divine knowledge would doubtless curse me in anger.

verses.text:
न चेयं रक्षितुं शक्या यथान्या प्रमदा नृभिः ।
मायावी हि सुरेन्द्रोऽसावहो प्राप्तोऽस्मि संशयम् ॥

meaning.en: She cannot be guarded by men as other women are, for the lord of the gods is a master of illusion. Alas, I am in doubt.

verses.text:
अवश्यकरणीयं हि गुरोरिह हि शासनम् ।
यदि त्वेतदहं कुर्यामाश्चर्यं स्यात्कृतं मया ॥

meaning.en: Yet the teacher's command must be carried out. If I do this, it will be a marvel that I have done.

verses.text:
योगेनानुप्रविश्येह गुरुपत्न्याः कलेवरम् ।
निर्मुक्तस्य रजोरूपान्नापराधो भवेन्मम ॥

meaning.en: By yoga I will enter my teacher's wife's body here. Since I will be freed from it, as from a stain of dust, there will be no offense in me.

verses.text:
यथा हि शून्यां पथिकः सभामध्यावसेत्पथि ।
तथाद्यावासयिष्यामि गुरुपत्न्याः कलेवरम् ॥

meaning.en: As a traveler lodges in an empty hall on the road, so today I will lodge in my teacher's wife's body.

verses.text:
असक्तः पद्मपत्रस्थो जलबिन्दुर्यथा चलः ।
एवमेव शरीरेऽस्या निवत्स्यामि समाहितः ॥

meaning.en: As a drop of water on a lotus leaf stays unattached and trembling, so I will dwell in her body, composed.

verses.text:
इत्येवं धर्ममालोक्य वेदवेदांश्च सर्वशः ।
तपश्च विपुलं दृष्ट्वा गुरोरात्मन एव च ॥

meaning.en: Thus considering dharma, the Vedas and their limbs in all respects, and seeing his teacher's great austerity and his own,

verses.text:
इति निश्चित्य मनसा रक्षां प्रति स भार्गवः ।
आतिष्ठत्परमं यत्नं यथा तच्छृणु पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: the descendant of Bhrigu, having decided in his mind about her protection, made the utmost effort. Hear how, king.

verses.text:
गुरुपत्नीमुपासीनो विपुलः स महातपाः ।
उपासीनामनिन्द्याङ्गीं कथाभिः समलोभयत् ॥

meaning.en: The great ascetic Vipula sat near his teacher's wife, who sat there with blameless limbs, and engaged her with stories.

verses.text:
नेत्राभ्यां नेत्रयोरस्या रश्मीन्संयोज्य रश्मिभिः ।
विवेश विपुलः कायमाकाशं पवनो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Joining the rays of his eyes to the rays of hers, Vipula entered her body as wind enters the sky.

verses.text:
लक्षणं लक्षणेनैव वदनं वदनेन च ।
अविचेष्टन्नतिष्ठद्वै छायेवान्तर्गतो मुनिः ॥

meaning.en: His signs with her signs, his face with her face, the sage stood motionless inside her, like a shadow.

verses.text:
ततो विष्टभ्य विपुलो गुरुपत्न्याः कलेवरम् ।
उवास रक्षणे युक्तो न च सा तमबुध्यत ॥

meaning.en: Then, having fixed himself in his teacher's wife's body, Vipula stayed, intent on guarding, and she did not notice him.

verses.text:
यं कालं नागतो राजन्गुरुस्तस्य महात्मनः ।
क्रतुं समाप्य स्वगृहं तं कालं सोऽभ्यरक्षत ॥

meaning.en: King, for the whole time until that great-souled man's teacher came home after completing his sacrifice, Vipula guarded her.
